description: physics.derailment new: an EU07 without a driver runs at 150 km/h into a curve of R 300 m without cant, a track of 150 m laid on its own in the fields of td.scn (autotest_curve), in a cutting with banks of 1:1.5 4 m high, the ground rising on beyond them at 1:5 (triangles of the fragment). Over its overturning speed (about 120 km/h) it overturns out of the curve: it runs into the bank on the outside of the curve, climbs it and stops sooner than on level ground.
